entries.title: Keep Automatic tasks beside the work they build on
entries.body: When model preferences are equal, Automatic now prefers the computer that ran a task’s basis if it can take the new work. Explicit computer choices still win. The task record explains when this preference decided the choice.
entries.noPicture: The rule changes start-time placement rather than a screen layout; the existing task record explains a basis-influenced choice in words.
